def factor_volume_regime_reversal_cont(df):
    """Adaptive mean-reversion with continuous volume-based blending."""
    df_copy = df.copy()
    ret = df_copy["close"].pct_change()
    rev_short = -ret.rolling(5, min_periods=5).sum()
    rev_long = -ret.rolling(20, min_periods=20).sum()
    _, _, vol_ratio = alpha_tools.classify_volume_regime(
        df_copy["volume"], window=20
    )
    w = vol_ratio.clip(0.5, 1.5)
    w = (w - 0.5) / 1.0  # maps [0.5,1.5] -> [0,1]
    factor = w * rev_short + (1 - w) * rev_long
    factor = pd.Series(factor, index=df_copy.index, name="factor_volume_regime_reversal_cont").fillna(0.0)
    return factor
description: Volume-regime adaptive reversal: uses continuous volume ratio from classify_volume_regime to smoothly interpolate between short-term (5-day) reversal, dominating in high-volume regimes, and long-term (20-day) reversal, dominating in low-volume regimes. The mutation replaces binary regime flags with a clipped linear weight from volume ratio (0.5 to 1.5) mapped to [0,1], providing smoother transitions and potentially improving IC and ICIR while preserving the high RankIC and MI of the elite parent.
